`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a contract-review model mandate for `skills/**` (clause ①). That mandate is waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03). This card ran on the project's default model, and the dispatching seat (domain:skills#3) runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md` 在 retention / ttl / archive 旁新增 § Sealing (`seal`):`lifecycle.seal` 让 `audit` 对象按小时封存成按组织成链的签名检查点;一个 `os:check` ✅ 例、一个 ❌ 例、编写期拒收、运行期"能解析但不封存"的原因,以及两条现有限制:还没有核验器读回检查点(篡改会被记录但不会被报告),到期修订(ADR-0154 P4)上线前清扫器仍会删封存行。评测 `objects-fields-relationships.json` 新增用例 16。
- 为什么改:PR #32348 给 lifecycle 块加了 `seal`(`Metadata-protocol: added`),技能侧的教学欠在这里。所有说法都按 `main` 的代码核对过;卡里有三处与 `main` 不同,按 `main` 教(见下方 "Card vs main")。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字、一条评测和一行 token 天花板,不改运行时;回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`rules/lifecycle.md` 的 § Sealing,以及下面 "Taught claims and their sources" 的逐条出处。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`(lifecycle.md 7721 B = 1931 tokens,正好等于新天花板);`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples`(新 ✅ 例通过类型检查)。
- 需要你做的:`check-governed-merges` 判为 **Tier H**(`skills/**`),保持 draft;490cf26d 的契约审查为 PASS 并带一条 should-fix,本 head 已修,还欠席位的 delta 复核;通过后席位再请你批准,请先不要批。

## Card vs main

Taught from `main`, where the card differs:
- **Per organization, not per chain alone.** The card says "a signed checkpoint per chain". On `main` a chain is an organization: one checkpoint per organization (the row's `tenant_id`) per hour, plus one deployment chain for rows with no `tenant_id` (`object.zod.ts:1054` "a per-organization checkpoint"; `sealer.ts:152` `tenantOf`).
- **Value fields are committed, not hashed in clear.** The card says "per-row value fields feed the leaf hash". On `main` every declared column enters the leaf in clear, and `valueFields` enter as salted commitments, so a checkpoint never carries their values (`object.zod.ts:1059-1062`; `canonical.ts:145-157` `sealedColumnSet`).
- **`id` is required too, not only `tenant_id`.** The sealer also needs a declared `id` field: the driver's primary key is not in the registered field map, so an object without it is reported "a sealed object must declare 'id'" (`canonical.ts:150-151`). Measured on the live engine (below). Note for the owning lane: the sealer's own report text ("Fix: give the object a 'tenant_id' field and only columns of a type with a canonical rule", `sealer.ts:242-246`) does not name `id`.

## Taught claims and their sources (main `26f4e6d8`)

| Taught | Source |
|:--|:--|
| `seal` makes an `audit` ledger tamper-evident | `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:1065-1066` |
| Ten minutes after each `created_at` hour | `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-seal/sealer.ts:69` (`AUDIT_SEAL_WINDOW_MS` 1 h), `:71` (`AUDIT_SEAL_SETTLE_MS` 10 min) |

| `tenant_id` stamped on insert | `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts:2064-2066` |
| ❌ `valueFields: ['created_at']`: id / created_at order the leaves | `object.zod.ts:3012-3013` |
| Refused: `seal` off class `audit` | `object.zod.ts:1162-1163` |
| Refused: a `valueFields` name not declared | `object.zod.ts:3016-3024` |
| Refused beside `seal`: `retention.onlyWhen`, `ttl.onlyWhen` ("any `onlyWhen`") | `object.zod.ts:1165-1169` |
| Refused beside `seal`: a `ttl` not on `created_at` (door: "measure the ttl from created_at") | `object.zod.ts:1171-1172` |
| Refused beside `seal`: rotation `storage` | `object.zod.ts:1174-1175` |
| Each deletes part of a sealed hour | `object.zod.ts:1156-1158` |
| Not sealed, reported at `error` hourly: no `id` / `tenant_id` | `sealer.ts:79` (`REPORT_REPEAT_MS`), `:212-217`, `:242-247` |

| Not sealed: a `password`, `secret`, `formula`, `summary`, `image`, `file`, `avatar`, `video` or `audio` column | `canonical.ts:96-110` (`AUDIT_SEAL_TYPE_RULES`, `null` rows); `sealer.ts:230-233` |
| Not sealed: no `cryptoProvider` on `AuditPlugin` | `sealer.ts:276-284` |
| An edit, insert or delete outside the platform breaks its signed checkpoints, but no verifier reads them back yet, so a break is recorded but not reported | no `os audit verify` under `packages/cli/src` and no checkpoint verifier under `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src` on main (ADR-0154 D9 not built; contract review 6799333005 finding 1) |
| Expiry (ADR-0154 P4) not built: the sweeper still deletes sealed rows, which then read as missing | `object.zod.ts:1067-1068`; no `seal` read in `packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/` |

**Measured, not only read.** A scratch `safeParse` on `main` (not committed) gave each of the seven refusals above at its path with the quoted message, and accepted `seal` beside `retention`, beside `retention` + `archive`, and beside a `ttl` on `created_at`. A scratch live-engine test (ObjectQL + SQLite wasm + `AuditPlugin` with a crypto provider; not committed) registered three authored objects: the skill's ✅ example was planned for sealing (its injected columns `organization_id`, `created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`, `updated_by`, `owner_id`, `owning_business_unit_id`, `queue` all have a rule); without `id` the sealer reported "a sealed object must declare 'id'"; without `tenant_id` it reported "it declares no 'tenant_id' field, so its rows cannot be chained per organization".

## The changed lines

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md`:

```diff
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
 Declaring how long an object's data lives and how its space is
 reclaimed (ADR-0057). Distinct from
 **lifecycle hooks** (`beforeInsert` / `afterUpdate` …), which run logic on
-writes: this page covers the rows' retention, rotation and archival.
+writes.
 
 ## Why This Exists
 
@@ -99,15 +99,9 @@ Duration literals: `<n>` + `h` / `d` / `w` / `y`.
 // ❌ Non-record class with no bounding policy — grows forever, exactly the bug
 lifecycle: { class: 'telemetry' }
 
-// ❌ Policies on record-class — business truth is permanent
-lifecycle: { class: 'record', retention: { maxAge: '30d' } }
-
 // ❌ archive.after must equal retention.maxAge
 lifecycle: { class: 'audit', retention: { maxAge: '90d' }, archive: { after: '30d', to: 'archive' } }
 
-// ❌ Free-form durations
-lifecycle: { class: 'telemetry', retention: { maxAge: '2 weeks' } }  // use '2w'
-
 // ❌ onlyWhen + rotation/archive — shard DROPs and the Archiver act on age
 //    alone and would destroy/move rows the filter protects
 lifecycle: {
@@ -131,6 +125,46 @@ lifecycle: {
   `telemetry`/`event`/`audit` object onto it — telemetry bloat can't touch
   the business DB.
 
+## Sealing (`seal`)
+
+`seal` makes an `audit` ledger tamper-evident (ADR-0154): an edit, insert or
+delete outside the platform breaks its signed checkpoints. Ten minutes after each `created_at`
+hour, `@objectstack/plugin-audit` signs its rows into a chained checkpoint
+per organization (`tenant_id`; rows with none share a deployment chain); late
+rows get a `late` checkpoint. Columns enter in clear, `valueFields` as salted
+commitments.
+
+<!-- os:check -->
+```typescript
+import { ObjectSchema, Field } from '@objectstack/spec/data';
+
+// ✅ The sealer needs declared `id` and `tenant_id`
+export const PolicyChangeLog = ObjectSchema.create({
+  name: 'policy_change_log',
+  sharingModel: 'private',
+  lifecycle: { class: 'audit', retention: { maxAge: '1y' }, seal: { valueFields: ['new_value'] } },
+  fields: {
+    id: Field.text({}),
+    tenant_id: Field.lookup('sys_organization', {}), // stamped on insert
+    new_value: Field.textarea({}),
+  },
+});
+```
+
+```typescript
+// ❌ Refused at parse time: id / created_at order the leaves
+seal: { valueFields: ['created_at'] }
+```
+
+Also refused: `seal` off class `audit`, an undeclared `valueFields` name, and
+beside `seal` any `onlyWhen`, a `ttl` not on `created_at`, or rotation
+`storage`. Not sealed, reported at `error` hourly: no declared `id` or
+`tenant_id` (the injected tenant column is `organization_id`); a `password`,
+`secret`, `formula`, `summary`, `image`, `file`, `avatar`, `video` or `audio`
+column; no `cryptoProvider` on `AuditPlugin`. Not built yet (ADR-0154): a
+verifier, so a break is recorded but not reported; expiry (P4), so the sweeper
+still deletes sealed rows, which then read as missing.
+
 ## Operations
 
 | Knob | Where | Effect |
```

## Cuts and their surviving homes

- The ❌ `lifecycle: { class: 'record', retention: { maxAge: '30d' } }` example: the Lifecycle Classes table's `record` row, "Business truth — permanent; policies FORBIDDEN".
- The ❌ `maxAge: '2 weeks'` free-form duration example: the line "Duration literals: `<n>` + `h` / `d` / `w` / `y`." under the Syntax block.
- The intro clause "this page covers the rows' retention, rotation and archival": the first sentence, "Declaring how long an object's data lives and how its space is reclaimed". (The page also covers sealing and the save notice, so the clause had become incomplete.)

No test, eval or script pins any cut text (grepped `packages/`, `scripts/`, `skills/`).

## Sweep

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md`: no sentence is made false by `seal`. "The platform LifecycleService sweeps declared policies hourly, deletes expired rows" stays true for sealed objects (the new section says the sweeper still deletes them). § Safety Semantics (archive-then-delete, rotation, separation) does not claim anything `seal` changes.
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/*.json`: no case teaches lifecycle policies (the two `lifecycle` hits in `objects-fields-relationships.json` cases 3 and 11 mean a status lifecycle). Nothing to fix.
- Other skills (`grep -rni "seal\|hash-chain\|tamper" skills/`): no hit outside this page, so the section is the one home. `objectstack-data/SKILL.md`'s index line for this page ("retention/TTL/rotation/archive policies") is not false, so `SKILL.md` is untouched.

## Eval

New case 16 in `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`: an audit log that must show direct database edits and keep the consent text out of the proof. `must_contain`: `seal`, `valueFields`, `tenant_id`, `salted commitments`, `read as missing`, `not reported` (added in round 3), each literally in `expected_output`; `must_not_contain`: `trackHistory`, `class: 'telemetry'`, neither in it (checked by script).

## Token ratchet

`rules/lifecycle.md`: main 6358 B = 1590 tokens (ceiling 1590). New section +1574 B, cuts -296 B: 7636 B = 1909 tokens. Ceiling 1590 -> 1909 under the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (seat ruling 6784259856 on #32364), pinned at the measurement, zero headroom. Round 3: the second limit adds +85 B with no same-file restatement left to cut, so 7721 B = 1931 tokens and the ceiling 1909 -> 1931 under the same amendment, as the seat's round-3 instruction allows. `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exits 0.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 62 commands for these four paths; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` (not derived) was run too, for the new `os:check` block. All 63 exit 0, measured at `ea92128e` (the branch with `origin/main` `20c7073b` merged) after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` and a full `pnpm build`, under `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`. Record: `/mnt/project-files/card-32364/gates-ea92128e.txt` in the project.

The head `c82aa39e` adds one more merge of `origin/main` (`26f4e6d8`, no change to this PR's four paths); at that head `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` and `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` were re-run and exit 0. `check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the four paths: GOVERNED, Tier H (`skills/**`).

**Round 2 (head `490cf26d`).** CI's `Type Check · consumer gates` lane went red on `Check docs object examples pass the os validate security posture` (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-security-posture`): the ✅ example declared no `sharingModel` (`security-owd-unset`). That gate is a whole-root family `dispatch-gates` does not derive, so the local run above missed it. Fix: the example declares `sharingModel: 'private'`, paid inside the same section so the file stays at 7636 B = 1909 tokens (`id: Field.text({})` drops `required: true`, which the sealer does not read; "made outside" -> "outside"; "one chained checkpoint" -> "a chained checkpoint"; "a declared" -> "declared"; "a `valueFields` name not declared" -> "an undeclared `valueFields` name"; one space before a `//`). The ratchet comment's arithmetic is unchanged. Re-run at `490cf26d`, each exit 0: `check:doc-security-posture`, `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `check:skill-examples` (after rebuilding `@objectstack/spec` on the merged tree), `check:doc-authoring`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:skill-links`, `check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`; the live-engine probe again planned the revised ✅ example for sealing.

**Round 3 (head `d877f052`).** Contract review 6799333005 on `490cf26d` was PASS with one should-fix: the page and eval case 16 said an outside edit "shows" while nothing on `main` reads a checkpoint back. One commit fixes it: the page now says an edit, insert or delete outside the platform "breaks its signed checkpoints", and names both limits ("Not built yet (ADR-0154): a verifier, so a break is recorded but not reported; expiry (P4), so the sweeper still deletes sealed rows, which then read as missing"). Case 16's `expected_output` says the same and gains `not reported` in `must_contain`; the changeset names both limits. +85 B with no same-file restatement left to cut, so the row is 1909 -> 1931 at the measurement (7721 B). Nits 2 and 3 stay as accepted deviations, as the seat ruled. Gates re-run at `d877f052`: the same 62 derived commands plus `check:skill-examples` and `check:doc-security-posture` (neither derived), 64/64 exit 0; record `/mnt/project-files/card-32364/gates-d877f052.txt`.
